title: Professional Email Terms: Billing Span of a Pro Upgrade
content:
**Clause.** The upgrade billing fraction of a Professional Email Pro upgrade turns on where today falls in the term:

(a) where the term runs 12 calendar months and today falls before the term start date plus the current product's cancellation window hours — 720 elapsed hours on Harborline Mail Starter and Plus, 168 on Microsoft 365 Business Basic and Standard — the hours counted in full 60-minute periods from 00:00 on the term start date and reaching the last hour closing the window, the fraction is 1 and the whole term is billed;

(b) where the term runs 12 calendar months, today falls outside that window and the term end date is from 1 to 60 calendar days after today, the fraction is the started 30-day periods from today to the term end date divided by 12, a started period counting as a whole one;

(c) where the term runs one calendar month and the term end date is from 1 up to 14 calendar days after today, the fraction is the whole weeks in those days, each counted as seven days, divided by the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date, Harborline's short-month convention;

(d) otherwise the fraction is the calendar days from today to the term end date divided by the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date.

## Edges

| Situation (hypothetical) | Paragraph | Fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 12-month Harborline Mail term, the 29th calendar day after the term start (696 hours elapsed at its start) | (a) | 1 |
| the same term, the 30th calendar day (720 hours) with 335 days left | (d) | 335 divided by the term's days |
| 12-month term outside the window, 60 days left | (b) | 2 divided by 12 |
| 12-month term outside the window, 61 days left | (d) | 61 divided by the term's days |
| 12-month term outside the window, 30 days left | (b) | 1 divided by 12 |
| one-month term of 30 days, 14 days left | (c) | 14 divided by 30 |
| one-month term of 30 days, 15 days left | (d) | 15 divided by 30 |
| one-month term of 30 days, 5 days left | (c) | 0 divided by 30 |
